labels.rationale: Usage question: the bar colour is set with complete_style on track(), which is documented.

items.body:
The bar colour is set with the `complete_style` parameter of `rich.progress.track`, which is the colour of the filled part. `finished_style` sets the colour once the task has finished, and `style` sets the unfilled background. For example:

```python
from rich.progress import track

for step in track(range(100), complete_style="green"):
    ...
```

The parameters are described in the [progress docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/progress.rst) and in [`rich/progress.py`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py). For usage questions like this, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the best place to ask.
